components.name: Motion control
components.description: Pause or resume ambient sculptural rotation.

narrative.overview: A saturated studio and a reflective, folded object make technology feel personal without impersonating a robot. Real geometry carries the sculptural material; ordinary scrolling carries the visitor. Page-scale ivory, midnight and yellow fields change the pace of the readable sections.
keyCharacteristics: Reflective lamination, rolled edges and concentric detail.
Wide squared lettering without diagnostic or terminal language.
Editorial spreads, aligned working-method rows, stepped interest essays and native navigation.

rules.name: The Field Rule
rules.body: Give a section a complete color field; do not distribute the palette into interchangeable cards.

dos: Do preserve readable, factual personal context and the real contact route.
Do self-host geometry runtime and display font.
donts: Don't add fake diagnostics, progress percentages, achievements or dates.
Don't reinterpret the sculpture as proof of a specific technical mechanism.
